_comment: SBI debit-card merchant offers, scraped from the bank's own offers page.
These are NOT rates. A rate drifts and gets stale; an offer ends on a date
and is then simply wrong to quote. So every entry carries valid_from and
valid_to where the page states them, and india.get_card_offers computes
active/expired against today rather than storing a flag that would rot.
Where the page gives no dates -- Cleartrip, Flipkart Travel, the business
card bundle, the Visa activation voucher -- valid_from and valid_to are
null and the capability reports dates_published: false. Inventing a window
would be worse than admitting there isn't one.
verbatim holds the page's own wording for each offer, so a reply can be
checked against the source without re-scraping.
